portedFromTheOracle.timer: src/game-loop.js updateDiving(), the 'Barotrauma check': ascentRate >= BAROTRAUMA_RATE (18 m/min) adds the frame's dive seconds, anything else takes off twice as many, to zero; BAROTRAUMA_TIME (10 s) ends the dive. The rate is the frame's own, legacy's ascentRate, from the depth before and after the physics.
portedFromTheOracle.order: The end checks in legacy's order: out of gas, O2 toxicity, the DCS timer, barotrauma, hypoxia, then surfacing with a ceiling. Legacy computes the timer after updateCCR()'s returns, so a step a rebreather failure ends leaves it alone.
portedFromTheOracle.text: STRINGS.{en,de}.gameOverReasons and gameOverInfo['PULMONARY BAROTRAUMA — PNEUMOTHORAX'], taken verbatim from src/constants.js by evaluating it in a Node vm, the label in the catalogue's sentence case, as gameOver.reason.pulmonaryBarotrauma and gameOver.info.pulmonaryBarotrauma.*; anchored under ASCENT-001 and GAMEOVER-001 for both locales.

decisions: Legacy also counts any ascent while the free-flow drill's held breath lasts (drillState.breathHoldUntilDiveSec). The drills are not migrated, so the model never holds its breath; the condition comes with the drills.
Save v14: older saves resume the timer at zero, whatever their payload carries; legacy saves keep barotraumaTime and resume at zero without it. Validation only requires a non-negative finite timer.
parity: barotrauma-runaway-ascent-30m, recorded in 60 Hz frames through legacy's buoyancy physics from neutral at 30 m on air, is replayed through DiveModel.advanceWithBuoyancy() with the same controls and frames: the depth after every frame, the timer, the ascent rate, the failure and the log at every checkpoint, the dive going on until legacy's last frame and ending on it. A second replay resumes from legacy's checkpoint with the timer at 2.4 s and fails on the same frame. The buoyancy recordings, which run the timer to 8.5 s, now compare it too. The scripted recordings set the depth before each tick, so their ascent rate is not legacy's and they are not compared.
fixture: Regenerated by npm run baseline:generate from the capture commit f7f07ae (referenceCommit). Additive: with state.debrief.barotrauma_s (52 values) and the new scenario removed, the fixture is identical to the one before; the test inventory differs only in referenceCommit.

counterChecks.method: Each revert was applied from a backup copy, the named unit and parity test files were run, and the file was restored; the tree was clean afterwards.
